answer: Because the bounty is drawn from the slashed bond, the meadow reward in the vault ledger burns the operator directly, and the zenith audit records each payout. The auditor that proves a junk submission collects 50% of the resulting slash, which pays for adversarial review out of the attacker's own capital. A farm of 252 keys hence funds the parties working against it, so growing the fleet makes it a larger target rather than a safer one. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
